frontier(big): terminal substrates (consumed, never produced) and terminal products of the paper's reactions, currency excluded, plus the enzymes of the steps touching them

queries: one Europe PMC query per frontier compound (substrates/products alternating), organism-scoped, built by rag.acquire.build_query; candidates round-robin across queries, deduped by PMID/PMCID/DOI

screen: dropped with a recorded reason when no identifier, input paper (PMID / PMCID / DOI / normalised title against big.sources.paper or the paper argument), preprint (Europe PMC source PPR, pubType Preprint, bioRxiv/medRxiv/Research Square/SSRN/arXiv... as publisher or journal), retracted, no journal record, title+abstract naming only other organisms (rag.admission.organisms_in_span + compare_organism; unknown and genus_level kept, recorded), over max_papers

text: abstract always (HTML stripped); full text via rag.acquire.fetch_full_text when the record is open access with a PMCID, cut into ~3000-char windows of whole statements (rag.admission.split_statements), the windows naming the most frontier terms kept (passages_per_paper)

extraction: rag.extract.extract_reactions_from_text per passage (evidence-bound prompt, fails closed); every model call counted (report.llm.calls, errors by type) and bounded by max_llm_calls; time checked before each paper and each passage

per reaction: quote must be a normalised (NFKC, whitespace collapsed, casefolded) exact substring of the passage, >= 20 chars (else quote_not_verbatim / quote_too_short); rag.admission.validate_evidence_span must accept the quote for the claim (participants, direction, catalysts); a catalyst the quote does not attach is dropped and the step re-checked without it; currency the quote does not name is dropped; quote naming another organism -> rejected; the step must touch a grounded, non-currency payload entity (else not_connected); no compartment is ever written; direction only as 'reversible' when the span states it (to the provenance note)

rows: convert.to_rows on a one-step neutral pathway (DB extension identity rules VD-11 / VD-13 unchanged), enzyme names the payload uses for a complex are attached as that complex; records relabelled {kind: other_paper, source, quote, stage: extension_lit, note: passage + organism verdict + to_rows note}; row 'provenance' field extension_lit; sources {kind, pmid, pmcid, doi, title, journal, year, url, retrieved} (+ blank db/accession); payload.merge_extension per step

fail-open: per query (search error -> recorded, next query), per paper atomic (any exception or the deadline passing mid-paper -> no rows from that paper, reason and accepted_discarded recorded); report.placement per source = merged_into_base / hop_1 / hop_2_plus / hop_none

dead_ends: rag.acquire.search_candidates not used for the search itself: its CandidatePaper drops the Europe PMC journal, pubType, source (PPR), pmid, pmcid and doi fields the peer-review screen and the input-paper match need. build_query, _EUROPEPMC_SEARCH, CandidatePaper and fetch_full_text are reused; the GET goes through vision.extend.http.get_text (deadline, URL cache, t2pw-vision User-Agent)

rag.admission.admit_candidates not used: it is gap-bound (needs detect_gaps output and admits only gap fillers). Its evidence core, validate_evidence_span (one statement, participants set-equal, direction, catalyst attached), is used per step, plus organisms_in_span / compare_organism
NCBI, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, bioRxiv not queried: Europe PMC indexes PubMed and PMC with journal metadata; bioRxiv is excluded by the peer-review rule

admission's span parser covers 'X converts A to B' / 'A is converted to B' shapes; 'EntA oxidizes A to B' is refused as roles_unassignable (probe, 2026-11-18). Live yield may be low; the refusals are counted per paper (rejected, rejected_samples)

open_questions: YIELD (needs decision, blocks the 10-step hand-check): 1 step admitted over 4 runs, and it only confirmed a paper step. Causes, largest first: Europe PMC timeouts (3/3 Listeria searches, 7/9 open-access full texts); abstracts rarely state one reaction; the rag.admission span parser refuses common shapes ('is first/further converted into ... by', 'is oxidized to ... by', 'are condensed into ..., catalyzed by'), 4 true steps lost in the audit. Options: (a) rerun live (v8-live-2) to get past the timeouts, no code change, may still give < 10 steps; (b) widen the span parser in rag/admission.py: outside this lane's boundary, changes RAG admission in the pipeline too, needs its own no-regression proof; (c) a literature-only relaxation inside literature.py (e.g. accept roles_unassignable when the one-statement verbatim quote names every participant and the catalyst), cheap but weakens the evidence bar the hand-check measures; (d) raise max_papers / LLM calls (more cost per run, abstracts add little). Recommendation: (a) now, then (b) as its own lane if yield is still low

Organism policy (needs PO): a paper whose title+abstract names only other organisms is dropped and a quote naming another organism is rejected; papers naming no organism ('unknown') and same-genus ones ('genus_level') are kept, with the verdict in every provenance note. Options: (a) keep as is (allow_unknown, like rag ORGANISM_POLICY_ALLOW_UNKNOWN); (b) strict: require 'match' (fewer steps, safer biology); (c) off. Cost of (a): an E. coli step can reach an L. lactis pathway when the abstract does not name the organism

Literature entities are not grounded (names only; they join payload rows by name or synonym). New entities therefore carry no ids, so a literature step that touches only another literature step is not_connected (hop chains stop at 1). Grounding via mapping/map_ids would be a later lane

Budget defaults (120 s, 8 calls) come from the brief; with a real model each call takes ~10-30 s, so a run reads 2-4 papers. The live proof uses 300 s / 12 calls. A call already started may overrun the deadline by its own timeout

Wiring: extend_big_payload does not dispatch 'literature' (passing it there is recorded as a failed source, fail-open). The wiring lane should call literature.run_if_enabled after the DB extension so DB rows are present for merges
Stoichiometry stated in a quote is not carried (convert.to_rows reaction rows have none, as for the DB extension)
